recalled_knowledge.item: Borexino 278 t PC+PPO (data 2007-2021); KamLAND ~1 kt; JUNO 20 kt LAB (commissioning 2025-26); SNO+ 780 t LAB and 905 t water phase
recalled_knowledge.reliability: certain (Borexino, KamLAND, JUNO mass) / likely (SNO+ masses, dates)

recalled_knowledge.item: PC = C9H12; LAB ~ C18H30; KamLAND scintillator 80% dodecane + 20% PC
thresholds: Borexino ~50 keVee hardware; KamLAND and SNO+ ~200 keVee physics; JUNO ~100 keVee trigger
14C/12C = 2.7e-18 in Borexino PC; ~1e-17 in LAB detectors
14C half-life 5730 yr, Q_beta = 156.5 keV, allowed spectrum with Fermi function
Birks constant kB = 0.0098 cm/MeV for LAB; LAB density 0.86 g/cm3
carbon-ion electronic stopping ~2500 MeV cm2/g at 300 keV (LSS, ~sqrt(E)), electronic fraction ~0.6; literature carbon quenching factors 0.02-0.06
Cecil-Anderson-Madey NE-213 proton light output L = 0.83E - 2.82[1-exp(-0.25 E^0.93)] MeVee
13C ground state 1/2-, p1/2 neutron; single-particle <S_n> = -1/6 (shell model ~ -0.17); abundance 1.07%; HO length b = 1.64 fm
SD scaling (J+1)/J (a_p<S_p>+a_n<S_n>)^2; spin averages <S_i S_j> = delta_ij/4; Anand dsigma/dE prefactor 2 m_T/(4 pi v^2)
sigma_n = 1e-47 cm2 ~ LZ 2024 SI limit at 1 TeV
Cherenkov: protons need >~480 MeV in water; sub-MeV ions give no light
exothermic kinematics E* = |delta| mu/m_N, half-width mu v sqrt(2 mu |delta|)/m_N, sigma v -> sigma_0 F^2 sqrt(2|delta|/mu)
LSS electronic stopping proportional to ion velocity at low energy
14C pile-up fraction estimate (~0.4% in 100 ns at 3e4 Bq) - qualitative only

failed_or_abandoned: Using WD.C13 directly as a WimPyDD target (TypeError: isotope object) and, in any case, 13C has itar = 0 so all its nuclear response functions vanish in WimPyDD; replaced by an analytic single-particle estimate validated against WimPyDD's 1H rate (0.94-0.97 agreement).

Cecil-Anderson-Madey light-output formula below 0.3 MeV (gives Q_p = 0.014 at 100 keV, an artefact of the fit); replaced by a Birks integration over a tabulated stopping power, Cecil kept as the low-side cross-check at 300 keV.
A 24-day annual mean of the endothermic Xe ROI count at delta = 380 keV differs from P021 by 45% (tail sampling); noted, not resolved (only enters kappa(380)).
NR/ER pulse-shape discrimination at 10-60 keVee in LAB: no reliable recalled value; treated as a free rejection factor (1, 1e-2, 1e-4) and as the rejection needed to match LZ.
